name: smwmusic-touhou-kaeidzuka-phantasmagoria-of-flower-view-the-cheating-tengu-wind-god-girl-remix
title: Touhou Kaeidzuka ~ Phantasmagoria of Flower View - The Cheating Tengu ~ Wind God Girl (Remix)
description:
"𝗡𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻, 𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗮 𝗻𝗲𝘄𝘀 𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆!"

Did an arrangement of Aya Shameimaru's theme from Touhou 9, Wind God Girl. It's a song that I've been meaning to do ever since I got into porting (like the many other songs I've said I wanted to do in the past lmao) and was one I was suggested quite often to do by many people. Glad to have done it. It's probably my favorite song from Touhou 9 and a really really really catchy theme from one of my favorite characters.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. E Minor (Custom Pitch)
